annotations.title: Crypto market overview: sentiment, prices, funding and signals

description: Market sentiment, prices and signals in one call: the Fear & Greed index with its 7-day change (alternative.me, attributed), the 10 most traded Hyperliquid perpetuals with price, 24-hour change, funding and open interest, technical readings (RSI, MACD, moving averages) for up to three coins, and Bitcoin fee rates. Cheaper than the five tools bought one by one. Use for a daily market brief, a trading agent's context or a dashboard. Example: coins=BTC,ETH,SOL. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
